headline: Eve Air Mobility reports $58.1 million loss in third quarter
summary: Eve, a subsidiary of Embraer, reported a net loss of $58.1 million for the third quarter of 2026, a 24% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The loss was attributed to higher research and development expenses.
why: Eve is a developer of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. As a growth-stage company in the aerospace sector, its R&D spending is a critical metric for investors.

impacts.name: Eve Air Mobility
impacts.why: Increased losses in a development-stage company can weigh on investor sentiment.
